Authorization bypass through user-controlled key in dmserver
Summary
An Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key [CWE-639] in FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, FortiManager Cloud and FortiAnalyzer Cloud could allow an authenticated administrator to access to other VDOMs via specially crafted HTTP requests.

Affected
Solution
FortiAnalyzer 8.0
8.0.0 through 8.0.1
